title: CreateAlertRuleRequest
description: POST /api/alert-rules body. `enabled` is optional — spray-json omits `None` on the wire, and the service normalizes an absent value to `true`.

condition.description: Opaque JSON object; the service validates `comparator`, `threshold` and the reserved history-baseline keys (`baseline`, `n`, `mode`) and passes any other key through unchanged.

baseline.description: Compare against output history instead of the bare threshold: comparator/threshold then apply to the delta between the current value and the baseline. Requires `mode`; the triggering run's own history point is excluded.

n.description: Number of prior history points averaged by `rolling_avg`. Required for rolling_avg, forbidden for previous, and rejected without `baseline`.

mode.description: abs: current - baseline; pct: (current - baseline) / |baseline| * 100. Required with `baseline`, rejected without it.
